title: The way in
starting_code:
# The great door is sealed, and listens for the school's word.
# It cannot hear anything while the seal holds!
hints: First, take two steps up to stand right before the great door.
The door only listens once its seal is broken. That means you must use the `cast` method to break the seal before you use the `say` method.
After you cast the spell and say the word, use the `move_up` method to take one last step into the hall.
intro: Here we are, the castle's great door! It is sealed by a rune, and it also listens for the school's word. But I am sure it will not hear a thing while that seal holds! Break the seal first, then say the word, and we will be in!
outro: It is opening! Look how bright the great hall is. Let us walk in together!
